# Alex Lende

Alex Lende is a principal software engineer and technical consultant. This site summarizes his work on maintainable product software, visual and media-heavy products, fully featured web applications, extensible product platforms, and engineering foundations.

## Site pages

- [Home](https://ajlende.com/): Overview of Alex's consulting focus, public proof links, working style, and contact section.
- [Resume](https://ajlende.com/resume.md): Plain Markdown version of Alex's resume for parsing, retrieval, and summarization.
